title: V5 debug: gate-poll optimization experiments — code toggles + 200s CY matrix
brief: Follow-on to iterative depth debug and pwm-coding baseline fix. Owner grants pwm-debug temporary LOGIC changes in pwmd (feature flags / env toggles / #[cfg(debug_assertions)] — no commit required per owner) to A/B test alternative optimizations against 20260606 V0/V1 baselines. Run new 200s CY smoke cycles on RESUMED (~34k) and optionally FRESH; up to 10 labeled variants combining toggles. Compare T100_est, pending p50/p95, propose/seal ratio, struck%. Pick winner or confirm coding track; hand diff to pwm-coding for formalization or revert all.

owner_permissions.keep_winner_diff: optional — document path for pwm-coding formalization

mandatory_runs: E0: coding baseline on resumed state (after coding lands)
experimental_toggles_examples: skip redundant record_cluster_prop_tick on deadline if ahead fired

acceptance_criteria: ≥2 valid runs on resumed state with coding fix (E0) measured vs 20260606 V0 (158s / pending 330)
≤8 additional experimental variants documented (toggle name + code location)
Explicit winner or tie-break rationale; ms attribution per top toggle
git status clean OR single documented patch left for pwm-coding with file list
Process cleanup: no stray pwmd after runs
non_goals: Permanent ungated production behavior without coding/review
Full 10-variant depth curve (500/5k) unless time permits — optional
